methodology.attempt: Hide future bars after an origin, forecast using only origin-time data, reveal later bars only for scoring.
lookahead_guards: Analog outcomes must be fully known before the origin.
Adaptive selector, Meta Hedge and Online Logistic update only from fully revealed earlier attempts.
Future-mutation tests verify later bars do not alter origin-time scores.
Minute scores are causal arrays and are future-mutation tested.
methodology.selection_bias_warning: The retrospective best after racing more methods is not expected future accuracy.

resolved -> re-use the fix; recurred on a fair sample -> retire and remember
validate survivors on the recent 30% slice and, if supplied, a second symbol
failure_memory.starved_sample_rule: fewer attempts/coverage than the screen minimum stops the diagnosis at sample quality; no direction rate is reported
failure_memory.goal_guard: goal_80_established is false in every code path

real_minute.note: No real minute dataset is bundled in v14; import lawful completed 1m/5m/15m bars.

versions.forecast_attempt_history: No hidden-future forecast-attempt race yet; atlas, Market Lab, tournaments and walk-forward measurement era.

versions.lesson: Unweighted look-alikes did not beat naïve rules.
No hidden horizon/regime pocket of skill.
Ensembling recovered part of the gap but costs erased value.
Candle anatomy did not reveal future direction.
Filtered accuracy requires coverage and costs.
Causal selection prevents leakage, not loss.
First primary-sample full-test wins over momentum, still fragile.
Kalman improved weak analog by >30% relative on both samples, not vs momentum.
Database scale improves comparison, not prophecy.
More classic/modern machinery and invented scores slightly raised selected historical maxima, while online logistic and neighbouring horizons demonstrate fragility.
v14 adds the minute measurement and operating workflow; it adds no real minute accuracy evidence and does not establish 80%.

safety_boundary.halal_screen: Evidence/rule workflow, not a fatwa or certification.
safety_boundary.external_usdt_btc: User own licensed account only; TradeAtlas mirror is unverified accounting.
safety_boundary.manual_tickets: Checklists only; never transmitted by TradeAtlas.

goals.title: Focus research and the bot on 1m/5m/15m bars
goals.evidence: Seven minute engines, a 1/3/5/15/30-bar hidden-future race, minute bot defaults and 1m public-data presets.

goals.title: Reach at least 80% out-of-sample direction accuracy
goals.current_real_evidence: v13 real daily/monthly samples reached 68% on one AAPL test and 63.077% pooled; no bundled real minute sample establishes a minute rate.

goals.title: Become a complete real trading bot
goals.implemented: Minute paper bot, risk halts, Start/Resume/Pause/STOP/flatten workflow and manual external execution tickets.
goals.not_implemented: No exchange/broker credentials, API-key storage, automatic order routing, leverage or shorting in TradeAtlas.
goals.next_gate: A separately reviewed testnet integration in the user's own licensed account would require security, legal, venue and halal-form review before any live automation.

goals.title: Let the user fund trading with USDT or BTC
goals.rule: USDT/BTC remain in the user's own licensed exchange account. TradeAtlas has no deposit address and must never receive or custody crypto.
goals.implemented: External-account balance mirror and paper conversion/transfer simulations; the mirror is user-reported and is not added to paper equity.

goals.title: Learn from every failed test instead of repeating it
goals.evidence: A cause library of 20 named failure modes, an avoid-rule and an implemented remedy per cause, a three-stage loop (screen -> apply lessons -> validate), resolved/recurred/retired lesson states, and a SQLite failure memory that makes later runs skip already-proven dead candidates.
goals.not_claimed: The failure memory improves the *research process*, not the market. It cannot create an edge that the sample does not contain, and it never lowers the 80% gates.

goals.title: Keep bot entries behind current halal evidence
goals.rule: Only registered assets whose current screen is exactly pass may enter even a paper/manual-ticket workflow.

project_goals.warning: Goals are not performance claims. Do not send money or crypto to TradeAtlas.
